title: CROSSWIRE-1 FAMILY-SWITCH CONTRACT (amended 2026-09-17 per .62 RCA adjudication R-1): qwen3.8-27b -> gpt-5.6-sol mid-session switch. The families differ, so the harness runs the switch-time LOSSY COMPACT instead of a verbatim transcript ride: the OLDEST post-switch sol request (last:0) is the compact turn — it carries the summarization instruction (faithful, concise summary) + the continuation framing (This session is being continued) and NO reasoning item (foreign qwen reasoning does not ride the family switch); the NEWEST sol request (last:1) is the continued S1 turn, also reasoning-free, and is ACCEPTED (200). Exactly TWO post-switch sol requests (sol_count 2..2 = the sibling bound that makes the last:0/last:1 selections unambiguous). The turn COMPLETES (no acp_error). Any deviation — reasoning in either sol request, a missing compact marker, != 2 sol requests, a non-200 final, or an acp_error — FAILs as a fix defect. (Pre-amendment expectation — verbatim reasoning ride + 400 + reactive strip+retry — is SUPERSEDED: on a cross-family switch the compact runs before any ride, so the 400-recovery contract never engages on this wire. Observed sw1e data point: exactly 2 sol requests, both 200, zero reasoning items, compact markers on the oldest.)

ndjson.label: TURN COMPLETES: the family switch + switch-time compact + S1 turn did not surface an ACP error (the compact is local; nothing is rejected on this wire).

wire.label: CONTROL (anti-vacuous pin): at least one pre-switch qwen request carried a reasoning INPUT item — real foreign reasoning existed to be (non-)replayed across the family switch. Without this the probe is meaningless.

COMPACT+TURN SHAPED: exactly two post-switch sol requests — last:0 = the compact turn, last:1 = the continued S1 turn. Sibling count bound that makes the last:N selections unambiguous (house rule: never a static selection without a sibling count).
COMPACT TURN (last:0 = oldest sol request): carries the summarization instruction — the switch-time lossy compact ran before the first sol turn.
COMPACT TURN CARRIES NO FOREIGN REASONING: the family switch dropped the qwen reasoning items (the lossy compact produces a portable transcript).
S1 TURN (last:1 = newest sol request) ALSO CARRIES NO REASONING: nothing re-introduced the foreign items after the compact.
S1 TURN RIDES THE COMPACTED CONTINUATION: the newest sol request replays the continuation framing seeded by the compact turn.
ACCEPTED: the final post-switch sol request reached 200 — the family-switch contract holds (the turn completed on the portable transcript).
FAMILY-SWITCH VERDICT RECORD: last-captured wire response status line, verbatim (machine-readable; the accepted 200 is the newest capture). recon op — always records, never fails.
